tasks.title: Academic Discussion
tasks.instruction:
Your professor is teaching a class. Write a post responding to the professor's question.
In your response, you should do the following:
• Express and support your personal opinion.
• Make a contribution to the discussion in your own words.
An effective response will contain at least 100 words.

professor.name: Dr. Gupta
professor.text: Next week, we will be discussing the impact of minimum wage laws on the economy. Minimum wage laws are designed to ensure that workers receive fair compensation for their labor. Some argue that raising the minimum wage helps reduce poverty and improve living standards, while others believe it can lead to job losses and increased costs for businesses. What are your thoughts on this issue? Are minimum wage laws good or bad for the economy overall?

posts.name: Claire
posts.text: Minimum wage laws provide a lot of benefits if they are handled properly. If there is no minimum wage, or if it is too low, many people will not be able to afford food, housing, and medicine even if they work hard. Raising the minimum wage reduces poverty and improves living standards. It ensures that workers can afford basic necessities and contribute to the economy.

posts.name: Andrew
posts.text: Increasing the minimum wage can lead to job losses and higher costs for businesses. Employers may cut jobs or reduce hours to offset the increased wages, which can negatively impact workers and the economy. The economy works best when prices and wages are determined by supply and demand, not by laws. So on the whole, minimum wage laws do more harm than good.
